decision_reason: Data.gov is a significant live federal service managed by GSA, and this public repository is part of its source, but the product family spans separate application repositories whose grants are not uniform or fully established. The GSA/data.gov root README says it is used primarily for team work tracking plus shared templates/egress and points to separate application repositories. GSA/datagov-catalog is the live catalog UI and has no root LICENSE; both LICENSE and LICENSE.md return 404. GSA/datagov-harvester states that government-authored project code is dedicated under CC0 but also says reused code is subject to GPL-2.0-or-later. The root repository's CC0 grant therefore cannot be generalized to all material Data.gov components. Hold pending an evidenced component-level license map and product-family scope; no product-wide license or first licensed-source year is assigned.

government_provenance.note: The official Data.gov About page identifies the service as the U.S. Government open-data site managed and hosted by GSA TTS and says its development is public on GitHub. The GSA/data.gov README ties this repository to the platform while distinguishing the separate application repositories.

public_source.note: The root repository is public and its README links the distinct public application repositories; datagov-catalog describes the deployed catalog UI and datagov-harvester documents the harvesting applications. This establishes public code, not a single product-wide license.

eligible_license.note: The root GSA/data.gov LICENSE.md grants CC0 only for that repository. The production catalog repository README identifies its code as the live catalog UI, but its root LICENSE and LICENSE.md endpoints return 404. The harvester LICENSE.md separately dedicates U.S.-government project work under CC0 and states that reused code is GPL v2 or later. These records do not establish a consistent eligible grant across the material service components.

primary_evidence.note: The first-party root README describes its role as primarily team work tracking and shared Data.gov code, and explicitly links the separate catalog, inventory, and www application repositories; the catalog README identifies catalog.data.gov as the production dataset discovery/search UI.

product_identity: Data.gov, U.S. Government open-data catalog and harvesting/discovery service (multi-repository product family)
agency: General Services Administration, Technology Transformation Services (TTS)

status_note: Live federal service. GSA/data.gov is primarily team work tracking plus shared templates/egress; material app code is distributed across linked repositories.
